env_variables.//CRIME_CORS_ORIGINS: Set to your Slate frontend origin, e.g. https://<app>.catalystserverless.com. LEFT UNSET on purpose: the API then uses its built-in allowlist (localhost + Catalyst hosting domains) instead of the '*' wildcard it used before, which let any website read the API.
env_variables.//CRIME_API_KEYS: Set to 'key:role,...' (roles: viewer|analyst|admin) to enforce RBAC on the person-level endpoints. While unset those endpoints are served WITHOUT authentication and the service logs a startup warning.
env_variables.//CRIME_HSTS: 1 - Catalyst terminates TLS, so pin browsers to HTTPS.
env_variables.//CRIME_RATE_LIMIT: Requests per CRIME_RATE_WINDOW seconds per client IP.
